root_cause.text: The `nft_map_catchall_deactivate` and `nft_map_catchall_activate` functions prematurely terminated their loops using a `break` statement after processing only the first catchall element, failing to deactivate or activate all pending catchall elements when a map was being removed during transaction processing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the `break;` statements from the loops in `nft_map_catchall_deactivate` and `nft_map_catchall_activate` in `net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c`, allowing the functions to iterate over and toggle all catchall elements instead of stopping after the first one.

vuln_statements.explanation: The break statement in nft_map_catchall_deactivate prematurely terminates the loop after deactivating the first catchall element, preventing other catchall elements from being deactivated.
The break statement in nft_map_catchall_activate prematurely terminates the loop after activating the first catchall element, preventing other catchall elements from being activated.
